saw_lines: Supplement buyers pick one flavour they trust, then reorder it for months, so the repeat sale depends on taste.
So the sale is lost when a new buyer sees a discount but no proof that the taste is worth trying.
Your site shows 7042 protein water reviews, yet none of your 30 live ads use them. Put the 11803 casein review count in the first line of two ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 4 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows 7042 protein water reviews, yet none of your 30 live ads use them, so doubtful buyers lack proof. Put the 11803 casein review count in the first line of two ads, with a buyer quote beneath.
7 of your 23 copy ads open on the same APP20 line, so new buyers meet one discount pitch and nothing else. Test two new openers against it: the 8 flavour sample pack and the 23.6g protein claim.
3 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, so a click for one item lands on the whole store. Point each of the 3 to the product its image shows, so the page matches the ad.

23 of your ads have run 60+ days, yet none of your 7 newer ads reuses their opening line, so a proven hook gets no second use. Build the next three as variations of your oldest winner, keeping its opening line.
